We want to substitute part of that collateral with investment-grade corporate bonds so we can free up some government bonds for an upcoming client settlement. The facility requires collateral valued at least 1.25 times the outstanding borrowing, so we need to maintain a minimum of $7,500,000 in collateral value. Before I sign off on the substitution, I need each of you to report any relevant requirements or concerns from your areas: collateral risk, legal, treasury operations, and relationship coverage. What do I need to know?
